data-* attributes store custom metadata on elements; JavaScript reads them through dataset.
Element එකකට custom data එකකේ දාන්න data-* භාවිත කරනවා. ඒක JavaScript dataset
Product buttons store product IDs for event handlers.
Read the numbered stages from top to bottom. data-product-id → 42; handler → select product.

<button id="buy" data-product-id="42">Buy</button>
<script>
 const b = document.querySelector("#buy");
 b.onclick = () => console.log(b.dataset.productId);
</script>
Expected result: Click Buy: console prints the string 42.
Interview question: Can data attributes store secrets?
Answer: No. They are visible to users and must not contain secrets.
